mapper.sql: log_id, user_id, admin_id, action, ip_address, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log(user_id, admin_id, action, ip_address, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{adminId}, #{action}, #{ipAddress}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT ol.log_id, ol.user_id, ol.admin_id, ol.action, ol.ip_address, ol.created_at, COALESCE(u.student_no, a.admin_no) AS student_no, COALESCE(a.admin_no, u.student_no) AS admin_no, COALESCE(u.role, a.role) AS role FROM operation_log ol LEFT JOIN user u ON ol.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN admin a ON ol.admin_id = a.user_id ORDER BY ol.created_at DESC
